# v4hooks

> Curated directory of Uniswap v4 hooks you can use. Not the official Uniswap hooklist address registry.

Site: https://v4hooks.com
Catalog JSON: https://v4hooks.com/hooks.json
Full dump: https://v4hooks.com/llm-full.txt
Contribute: https://github.com/v4hooks.com (see CONTRIBUTING.md)

## Hooks
- [Angstrom](https://v4hooks.com/hooks/angstrom): LP-defending DEX that gates swaps through a staked validator set.
- [Arrakis](https://v4hooks.com/hooks/arrakis): Private and managed Uniswap v4 inventory with vault-style LP hooks.
- [Bunni](https://v4hooks.com/hooks/bunni): Shapeshifting LP manager that pairs swap fees with lending yield.
- [Clanker](https://v4hooks.com/hooks/clanker): Meme coin launchpad with protocol fee routing and MEV-aware modules.
- [EulerSwap](https://v4hooks.com/hooks/eulerswap): AMM hooked into Euler lending so swaps tap the same inventory LPs already posted.
- [Flaunch](https://v4hooks.com/hooks/flaunch): Fair launchpad that routes 100% of trading fees to creators and buybacks.
- [Full range](https://v4hooks.com/hooks/full-range): v2-style full-range liquidity as a Uniswap v4 hook.
- [Geomean oracle](https://v4hooks.com/hooks/geomean-oracle): Turn a Uniswap v4 pool into a geometric-mean price oracle.
- [Limit order hook](https://v4hooks.com/hooks/limit-order): Place onchain limit orders that fill when the pool trades through a tick.
- [New York trading hours](https://v4hooks.com/hooks/trading-days): Revert swaps while New York equity markets are closed.
- [Pubhouse](https://v4hooks.com/hooks/pubhouse): Permissionless prediction markets whose trading rails are a Uniswap v4 hook.
- [SafeSwap](https://v4hooks.com/hooks/safeswap): Anti-rug and anti-whale v4 hook with sell limits, cooldowns, and launch mode.
- [Stop-loss hook](https://v4hooks.com/hooks/stop-loss): Close a position automatically when the pool trades through a stop price.
- [Super DCA](https://v4hooks.com/hooks/super-dca): TWAMM-style DCA with dynamic fees and a Curve-like gauge for rewards.
- [TWAMM](https://v4hooks.com/hooks/twamm): Time-weighted average market maker for slicing large orders onchain.
- [Unimon](https://v4hooks.com/hooks/unimon): NFT battle game whose mint and state live inside a Uniswap v4 hook.
- [veLP](https://v4hooks.com/hooks/velp): Curve-style vote-escrow for Uniswap v4 liquidity positions.
- [Volatility fee hook](https://v4hooks.com/hooks/volatility-fee): Dynamic swap fees driven by realized volatility to protect LPs.
- [Zora creator hook](https://v4hooks.com/hooks/zora-creator): Creator-coin launch rails with fee conversion and reward split.
